The World Bank's International Debt Report 2026, released on 5 November 2026, gives insights into what countries owe and to whom. Pakistan’s total external debt almost doubled to $135.1 billion over the decade (2015-2025), whereas India's increased 59.4%. The overall debt has risen in the subcontinent, with an exception- China.
Episode 1933 looks at the important data, and what it says about countries' borrowing. ThePrint Editor-In-Chief Shekhar Gupta also breaks down where each country stands, in terms of the burden due to borrowing, and how a higher borrowing, does not imply higher burden.
